verses.text: Ha winhaj Eliseo schekab' Dios, ix yawtej jun winh yetchekab'wumal winh kelemto, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ak' lista a b'a, tzach b'at t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad. Ik'b'at jun yet'tal akeite tik tzach b'ati.

Ayik tzach k'och ta', tza sayanek' winhaj Jehú yuninal winhaj Josafat yixchikin winhaj Nimsi. Tzach och b'aj ayek' winh chi', tzik'anelta winh t'a skal heb' winh ayek' yet' winh ta', tzik'anb'at winh t'a junokxo kuarto.

Slajwi chi' tzik'ankot akeite chi', tza tob'ank'e t'a sjolom winh, tzalan t'a winh icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha in tzach in sik'kaneli yik ol ach och reyal t'a Israel, xchi, xa chi. Slajwi chi' tza jakan puerta, tzach el lemnajok, manh ach och waan, xchi winhaj Eliseo chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh kelem schekab' Dios t'a Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad chi'.

Ayik ix k'och winh ta', molanek' masanil heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado, ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ach in kapitán, ay wal jab' tas ol wal t'ayach, xchi winh. --¿Mach junok onh b'aj tzal chi'? xchi winhaj Jehú. --Ach in kapitán, a ach ton tzach wala', xchi winh t'a winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix k'e juknaj winhaj Jehú chi', ix och winh t'a yol pat. Ix yak'ank'e akeite winh schekab' Dios chi' t'a sjolom winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha Jehová ko Diosal tz'alan t'ayach icha tik: Ha in tzach in sik'kaneli, yik ol ach och reyal t'a in chonhab' Israel.

Ha ach ol a satel masanil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab, winh ayach t'a yalanh smandar. Icha chi' ol aj in pakan schamel heb' winh in chekab' yet' heb' winh tz'alanel in lolonel, yujto elnak schiq'uil heb' winh yuj ix Jezabel.

Masanil heb' yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi', yowalil ol satel heb'. Masanil heb' winak, wach'chom chekab' yaji, ma yik sb'a, ol satel heb' t'a chonhab' Israel. Manhxa junok yinhtilal winh chi' olto kanok.
Icha wutejnak yinhtilal winhaj Jeroboam yuninal winhaj Nabat, icha wutejnakpax yik winhaj Baasa yuninal winhaj Ahías, icha wal chi' ol wutej yinhtilal winhaj Acab chi'.

Haxo pax ix Jezabel jun, a nok' tz'i' ol chianb'at sniwanil ix t'a yol yik Jezreel, manhxalaj mach ol mukan ix, xchi Jehová, xchi winh schekab' Dios chi'. Ayik ix lajwi yalan masanil juntzanh tik winh schekab' Dios chi', ix sjakan spuertail jun pat chi' winh, ix b'at winh elelal.

Ayik ix k'ochxi winhaj Jehú chi' b'aj molanek' heb' winh yetyajalil chi', ix sk'anb'an heb' winh t'a winh: --¿Tas xchi, wach' ama? ¿Tas yuj ix ul ach yil jun winh kistal chi'? xchi heb' winh. --Ha ex tik eyojtakxo winh, eyojtak tas syaltaxon heb' winh schekab' Dios chi', xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

--Maay, manh kojtakoklaj, al t'ayonh tas ix ul yal winh, xchi heb' winh. Ix tak'wi winhaj Jehú chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ix yal winh t'ayin icha tik: Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Ha in tzach in sik'kanel sreyalok Israel tiknaik, xchi Jehová, xchi winh t'ayin, xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', junjun heb' winh ix yik'el sjukan pichul, ix slich'anem heb' winh t'a yalanh yok winhaj Jehú b'aj b'akhkiltak sk'ei. Ix laj spu'an sch'aak heb' winh, te chaanh ix yal heb' winh: Ha winhaj Jehú, reyxo winh, xchi heb' winh.

Ha winhaj Jehú yuninal winhaj Josafat yixchikin winhaj Nimsi, te chuk tas sna winh t'a yib'anh winhaj Joram. Ha winhaj Joram chi', aynhejoch winh yet' heb' yetisraelal skolanelta chonhab' Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj Hazael sreyal Siria.

Palta ayxo jaye' k'u sk'och winh t'a Jezreel yik syanhtan sb'a winh b'aj ix lajwi yuj heb' sirio chi' ayik ix yak'an owal winh yet' winhaj Hazael chi'. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú t'a heb' ajun yet'ok: Tato t'a wal yel he gana tzin och he reyalok, malaj junok mach tz'el t'a yol chonhab' tik yik wach' malaj mach sb'at halan jun ab'ix tik t'a heb' winh aj Jezreel, xchi winh.
Ix k'e winh t'a yol skarruaje yik owal, ix b'at winh t'a Jezreel b'aj wan yanhtan sb'a winhaj Joram chi'. Aypaxek' winhaj Ocozías sreyal Judá ta', yujto ayk'och winh yil winhaj Joram chi'.

Ayik ix yilanb'at winh ayk'e t'a chaanh stanhwej chonhab' Jezreel chi' to wan sjawi winhaj Jehú yet' jun nhilanh heb' soldado, ix el yaw winh, ix yalan winh: --Ay juntzanh heb' soldado wan sjawi, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix yal winhaj Joram chi' icha tik: --B'atokab' junok winh soldado t'a yib'anh chej, yik b'at yil winh mach jun sjawi chi', sk'anb'anpax t'ay, tom t'a ak'ank'olal sjawi, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix b'at jun winh soldado t'a yib'anh chej chi' yik b'at yil winh, ix yalan winh: --Ha winh rey tzin chekankot in k'anb'ej t'ayach, tom ak'ank'olal tzach jawi, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh: --Ha ach tik, malaj halan ik t'a jun tik, anhej to tzach och tzak'an wuuj, xchi winh. Haxo ix yalanxi winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi' icha tik: --Ha winh chekab' chi', ix k'och winh b'aj wan sjawi heb' chi', palta malaj winh smeltzaji, xchi winh.

Wal t'a jun rato chi' ix chekjib'at junxo winh soldado t'a yib'anh chej yuj winh rey chi'. Ix k'och winh soldado chi' t'a heb', ix yalan winh: --Ha winh rey tzin chekankoti yik tzul in k'anb'an t'ayach, tom ak'ank'olal tzach jawi, xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winh: --Ha ach tik, malaj halan ik t'a jun tik, anhej to tzach och tzak'an wuuj, xchi winh.

Ix yalanxi winh stanhwumal chonhab' chi': --Hanheja' junxo winh chi' ix k'och winh t'a heb', palta malaj winh smeltzaji. Ha mach sja t'a yol karruaje chi', ichato a winhaj Jehú yixchikin winhaj Nimsi, yujto te lokotak skot winh, ichataxon smodo, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winhaj Joram chi': --Hak'uekoch nok' chej t'a in karruaje yik owal, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ix b'ochaj skarruaje winhaj Joram sreyal Israel chi' yet' pax yik winhaj Ocozías sreyal Judá. Ix b'at heb' winh junjun t'a yol skarruaje chi'. Ix b'at schaan winhaj Jehú chi' heb' winh. Ix schalaj sb'a heb' winh t'a lum sluum winhaj Nabot t'a yol yik Jezreel.

Ayik ix yilan winhaj Joram chi' to a winhaj Jehú sk'ochi, ix yalan winh: --Ach Jehú, ¿tom t'a ak'ank'olal tzach jawi? xchi winh. Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi': --Tom ijan ak'ank'olal tzin jawi yakb'an a ix a nun ix Jezabel, hanheja' yak'anem sb'a ix t'a juntzanh sdiosal yet' t'a yajb'aalil, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Joram chi', ix el lemnaj winh, ixto awajkan winh t'a winhaj Ocozías chi': --Ocozías, chamel jun tik, xchi winh.

Yuj chi' a winhaj Jehú chi' yet' wal yip winh ix sjulb'at sjul-lab' t'a winhaj Joram chi', awal t'a snanhal yich spatik winh ix ochi, ix k'axpaj t'a spixan winh. Yuj chi' ix telwi winh t'a yol skarruaje chi', ix cham winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a winhaj Bidcar, winh skolwaj yet'ok: --Ik'elta winh t'a yol skarruaje chi', tza yumankanb'at winh t'a yol smakb'enkan winhaj Nabot aj Jezreel, yujto tzato in nakoti to a ach jun wet'nak ach ayik tzak'an onh och t'a spatik skarruaje winhaj Acab smam jun winh tik, ayik yalannakkan jun lolonel tik Jehová t'a yib'anh winhaj Acab chi' icha tik:

Ha ewi wil schamel winhaj Nabot yet' heb' yuninal. Hanheja' icha wal chi' ol aj wak'an spak t'ayach t'a jun lugar tik, xchi Jehová. Yuj chi' ik'elta sniwanil winh chi', tza julankanb'at t'a lum sluumkan winhaj Nabot chi', yujto icha chi' ajnak yalan Jehová, xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.

Ayik ix yilan winhaj Ocozías sreyal Judá tas ix uji chi', ix el lemnaj winh, ix b'atkan winh t'a sb'eal Bet-hagán, palta ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi' t'a spatik winh, ix yalan winh: --Milekpaxcham jun winh tik, xchi winh. Ix yamchaj winhaj Ocozías chi' yuj heb' t'a switzal Gur t'a slak'anil Ibleam. Hata' ix lajwi winh t'a yol skarruaje chi' yuj heb', palta ixto yal yel winh, masanto ix k'och winh t'a Meguido. Hata' ix cham winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix ik'jib'at sniwanil winh yuj heb' winh schekab' t'a Jerusalén t'a yol jun karruaje. Ix mukchaj winh b'aj mukan heb' smam yicham t'a schonhab' winhaj rey David.
Ha winhaj Ocozías chi', ix schael yich winh yak'an reyal t'a Judá ayik yuxluchilxo ab'il yoch winhaj Joram yuninal winhaj Acab reyal t'a Israel.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi' t'a Jezreel. Ayik ix yab'an ix Jezabel tas ix uji chi', ix yak'an uk' stitak sat ix, ix sjixb'an sjolom ix, ix elta t'anhan ix t'a jun wentena.
Ayik ix k'och winhaj Jehú t'a ti' chonhab' chi', ix yalan ix t'a winh icha tik: --¿Wach'am a k'ool? Lajan ach yet' winhaj Zimri, ix a milcham winh ajalil, xchi ix.
Ix k'e k'elan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a jun wentena chi', ix yalan winh: --¿Mach ayoch wet'ok? xchi winh. Ay chawanh oxwanh heb' winh munlajwum t'a yol spat ix, ix elta t'anhan heb' winh yila'.

Ix yalan winhaj Jehú chi' t'a heb' winh: --Ekek emta jun ix ix chi' t'a tik, xchi winh. Ix yekankot sutnaj ix heb' winh, ix laj och tzipnaj schiq'uil ix t'a sattak yich pat chi' yet' t'a nok' chej, haxo nok' chej chi' ix ek' t'a yib'anh sniwanil ix chi' yet' skarruaje.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Jehú chi' wael. Ayik ix lajwi swa winh chi', ix yalan winh: --Ilek tas tzeyutej jun ix ix te chuk chi', yujnhej to yisil ix winh rey, yuj chi' mukchajokab' ix, xchi winh.
Ayik ix b'at heb' winh smuk sniwanil ix yalani, ix yilan heb' winh to haxonhej sb'akil sjolom ix, yok ix yet' sk'ab' ix ayeq'ui.

Haxo ix paxta heb' winh, ix yalan heb' winh t'a winhaj Jehú tas yaji, ix yalan winh: --Icha tik ix aj yelk'och tas scheknak Jehová yal winhaj Elías aj Tisbe, winh schekab' to a nok' tz'i' ol chianb'at sniwanil ix Jezabel t'a yol yik Jezreel.

Ha sniwanil ix chi', stza' nok' nok' ol ajkanb'atok, yuj chi' yalxonhej b'aj ol kan t'a sattak lum lum t'a yol yik Jezreel, malaj mach ol alanok: Ina b'aj mukan ix Jezabel tik, manh xchiok heb', xchi Jehová, xchikan winhaj Elías chi', xchi winhaj Jehú chi'.
